div.t-attf-style: background-color: #{'#1f8a95' if state[0] == 'done' else '#45b318' if state[0] == 'cust_review' else '#b34318' if state[0] == 'dev' else '#1f2e95'}

div.title: Following tasks are either in development/testing/to-be-consult/code-review states.

span.title: Following tasks are still in planning state, yet to be started.

div.class: tasks_wrapper p-1 mr-2 d-flex flex-column h-100

t.t-if: not task.approved_hours and task.is_visible_dashboard and task.timesheet_ids and sum(task.timesheet_ids.mapped('unit_amount'))

div.class: row d-flex justify-content-start col-12 mt32 mb16

t.t-value: len(project.task_ids.filtered(lambda l: l.bugs_type in ['production_bug', 'staging_bug'] and l.state == 'dev'))

div.span:
Bug Status:
No Active Bugs
Bugs Identified (Resolution in Progress) Bug Identified (Resolution in Progress)

tr.t-attf-class: {{'text-danger' if testcase.outcomes == 'bug' else 'text-success' if testcase.outcomes == 'expected' else ''}}

t.t-value: round(sum(sum(timesheet_by_subtask.mapped('approved_hours') or 0.0) for timesheet_by_subtask in timesheets_by_subtask.values()), 2) or 0.0
